correctness.rationale: Exact multinomial exclusion gives \(C(t)=G(1-2t)-G(1-t)^2=t^2F(t)\). For \(N\le3\), \(v\ge w\ge0\) makes \(F\) strictly concave when \(\Pr(N\ge2)>0\) on \(0<t<1/2\), forcing at most two zeros. For \(N\le2\), \(F(t)=2c-(b+2c-ct)^2\) increases strictly if \(c>0\), forcing at most one. Exact rational three-copy masses \((1/4,7/16,1/32,9/32)\) give negative-positive-negative signs at \(1/12,1/8,2/5\); the first root is \(1/9\) and the second lies in \((3/8,2/5)\). All definitions and quantifiers were checked against the proof; `check.py` passed 102356 supplementary exact-rational assertions.

value.rationale: PCR technical replicates with low template count are a motivated setting where the sign of co-detection association may guide overdispersion and error interpretations. This theorem provides an exact sharp minimal copy count for two successive sign reversals and a universal two-reversal upper bound over all allowed distributions, not an arbitrary parameter slice. It demonstrates that unchanged extract heterogeneity plus changed aliquot volume alone can produce negative–positive–negative covariance. The result is self-contained, has concrete inference caveats and does not claim field calibration.
